maya (research): quick flag: onboarding eval for rerank-tiny-ptq shows ndcg@10 +1.3% but mrr@1 -2.0% vs fp16 on holdout-delta.
ezra (ml): hmm. same harness/seed?
maya (research): yes. cmd: `./eval/run --model rerank-tiny-ptq --set holdout-delta --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 99`
ci-bot: build 61200 completed  results: https://ci.redwood.ai/61200 
sam (infra): runtime used asymmetric-PTQ with new output-normalizer landed last sprint. no revert yet.
tara (prod): did we change how snippets are merged? last night we enabled "compact snippet merge" for SERP.
maya (research): replicated with two input protocols: "atomic-cands" (keep each passage separate) and "compact-merge" (merge top3). inversion concentrated on compact-merge: top1 flip-rate compact=5.8%, atomic=0.8%.
ezra (ml): that pattern fits: quantization reduces pairwise logit margins and occasional kernel bias pushes lower-ranked relevant docs to top1, hurting mrr while ndcg can increase if more relevant docs rise overall.
sam (infra): possible causes: output-normalizer scaling, small clamp in int8 kernel, or token separator differences when merging. i'll diff the normalizer commit.
maya (research): sample trace (scores truncated):
```
# QID: Z449
fp16: docA=4.30 (rank1), docB=3.95 (rank2)
ptq : docA=4.10, docB=4.14 -> flip
# gap 0.35 -> -0.04
```
ezra (ml): quick mitigation experiment: multiply PTQ logits by 1.02 and recompute metrics; also try lowering softmax temp on PTQ path to 0.98.
maya (research): did the 1.02 rescale: mrr recovers ~+1.7% and ndcg stays +1.0%. flip-rate drops ~60% on compact-merge. temp tweak had smaller effect.
sam (infra): i'll run kernel-revert in staging and compare. if kernel change is culprit we revert; otherwise we can expose a per-model "logit_multiplier" in serving as a stopgap.
tara (prod): operational note: if multiplier is needed, we should document hotpatch steps and add monitors: flip-rate, top1-change, and user-facing CTR.
ezra (ml): also adding a small nightly CI probe that computes fp16->ptq top1 flip-rate and logs sample ids to s3 for human review.
maya (research): adding a small "pairwise-drift" summary to the eval report (mean delta, std, flip-rate). will post follow-up after kernel revert job. :thumbsup:
